role_line: Multidisciplinary engineering developer and systems integrator
core_message: I engineer intelligent systems that connect the physical world to software, data, automation, and artificial intelligence.
tagline: FROM HARDWARE TO CLOUD. FROM DATA TO INTELLIGENCE.
intro: I work across the boundary between operational technology and information technology: field sensors, industrial PLCs and edge computers on one side; APIs, databases, dashboards, business systems and AI tooling on the other.
Most of what I build is a complete chain rather than an isolated component. A pulse from a meter, an input on a PLC or a GPS fix becomes a record, an alarm, a report or a decision for an operator.

The systems run in the field, so I design for what the field actually does: connectivity drops, devices reboot, operators are busy, and data still has to arrive once, in order, with the right timestamp.

approach: Start from the physical process and the operator, then choose the hardware, protocols and software that fit it.
Keep local logic at the edge so the site keeps working when the uplink does not.
Treat data integrity as a requirement: device identities, timestamps in the right timezone, idempotent sync and an audit trail.
Prefer dense, readable operational interfaces over decorative ones.
Use AI where it measurably helps engineering work, and say plainly where it is still an experiment.
